project_name.description: Nickname for the project account being deployed

new_existing_account.description: A sentence from the account creation form indicating whether the request is to migrate an existing account or create a new account

account_point_of_contact_email.description: The primary account administrator and point-of-contact

primary_account_email.description: The contact for processing the account request and for questions regarding the account

budget_authority_email.description: The person authorized to use the UC Davis billing code included in the payload. Added to the billing read group

separate_billing_contact.description: The contact that should be used if an alternate billing contact is indicated

separate_technical_contact.description: The contact that should be used if an alternate technical contact is indicated

estimated_spend.description: The amount the group expects to spend monthly on the cloud account

data_types.description: The data types that will be stored in the cloud account

protection_level_classification.description: The IS-3 P-level classification of the data

availability_level_classification.description: The IS-3 A-level classification of the data

confirm_authorization.description: Confirmation that the submitter is authorized to request an account

confirm_purpose.description: Confirmation that the purpose of the cloud account has been accurately attested

confirm_data.description: Confirmation that the data types being stored in the account have been accurately described

cloud_provider.description: An abbreviation of the cloud provider in which the account is being provisioned

request_number.description: The ServiceNow reqeust ID number (the RITM)

received from.description: The user approving the form submission

submitted_by_user.description: The user who approved the form submission
